text:
maria: Hi team — we're greenlighting a pilot customer that needs mixed L4 + H100 capacity in us-central1 and europe-west4. Need a GCP onboarding + quota bump for GPUs and additional external egress IPs. Can we get an owner to file the request?

raj: I can own filing, but need exact numbers and the billing host project. Also confirm whether this is shared-VPC or standalone.

kyle: It's shared-vpc (prod-shared-host). Pilot will use dedicated projects per customer but share networking. Request: 8 x a2-highgpu-1g (A100) in us-central1, 16 x a2-highgpu-1g in europe-west4, and 24 x l4 in us-central1 for burst. Plus 10 static external EIPs for NAT+whitelisted egress.

aisha: Also add 4 x h100 standard for low-latency experiments in us-central1 — prefer quota for H100 rather than requesting runtime preemption fallbacks.

maria: totals: US-central1: 8 A100 + 24 L4 + 4 H100; EU-west4: 16 A100. Network: 10 external IPs, increase Cloud NAT ephemeral quotas if needed.

raj: Cool. Two gotchas: 1) Shared VPC host project needs Compute Engine API & quota owner role to process quota increases. 2) For H100/L4 we should request "accelerator quota" and include machine type names and whether GPUs are local to zones. GCP often asks for use-case justification and anticipated sustained usage (QPS / hours/day).

kyle: Suggested justification: "piloting Redwood Dedicated for customer X — production inference work; sustained expected utilization 200 GPU-hours/day initially for 2 months, scaling to 800 GPU-hours/day after successful test. Need predictable low-latency variants (H100) and burst L4 pool for cost-sensitive workloads."

raj: I'll prepare the form. Quick checklist for the ticket: billing host project id, shared-vpc host id (prod-shared-host), list of zones (us-central1-a/b, europe-west4-a/b), machine types + accelerator type, target start date, duration, anticipated sustained hours, contact person + phone, estimate monthly spend.

aisha: Networking: ask for increase to "Forwarding rules" and "External IP addresses" quotas in both regions, and confirm Cloud NAT maximum connections per second. Also request relaxed quota on EGRESS bandwidth (if possible) — previous requests got rejected unless we include traffic patterns.

maria: Who can sign off on cost? Finance needs a rough monthly estimate to approve the reserved quota. Kyle, can you bring a ballpark?

kyle: Ballpark: first month ~ $120k (GPU hours + egress + storage), then ramp. I'll send a short cost memo to finance and loop in @maria.

oncall-bot: [deploy-bot] New quota request ticket created: GCP-QUOTA-2187 by raj. Status: in-progress. Link: https://gcp-console/quotas/GCP-QUOTA-2187

raj: Pasting the initial request body I'll submit — please review and edit before I hit send:
```
Project: prod-shared-host (host project for shared VPC)
Regions/Zones: us-central1 (a,b), europe-west4 (a,b)
Accelerators requested: 4 x h100 (us-central1), 8 x a100 (us-central1), 24 x nvidia-l4 (us-central1), 16 x a100 (europe-west4)
External IPs: 10 static external IPv4 addresses (for NAT egress and customer whitelists)
Quotas to increase: Accelerators (H100/A100/L4), CPU/GPU quota per region, Forwarding rules, External IP addresses, Cloud NAT ephemeral ports
Justification: Redwood Dedicated pilot for customer X. Initial sustained usage 200 GPU-hours/day expected, scaling over 2 months to 800 GPU-hours/day. Low-latency requirement for H100-backed endpoints. Need EIPs for static egress and customer firewall whitelists.
Contact: raj@redwood.com, +1-555-0102
Duration: 6 months (review sooner if underutilized)
Billing: Finance approval pending — contact finance@redwood.com for PO
```

maria: Looks good. Add a note that we can fallback to reduced H100 capacity if GCP asks for phased approvals: request immediate approval for L4 and A100, with H100 as "phase 2" that can be expedited if early utilization metrics are met.

raj: Good call — I'll add phased approach and explicit staging in the form. Also attaching expected node images (gke/gce) and IAM service account used for provisioning so GCP can validate quotas against the host project.

aisha: One more ask: include an ask for "quota increase to allow regional burst pools" — some GCP reps don't realize we want short-lived autoscaling pools (preemptible vs non-preemptible). Clarify we need both preemptible and on-demand accelerator quota.

raj: Done. Submitting now. Ticket GCP-QUOTA-2187 created and assigned to GCP onboarding team. ETA from support usually 3-7 business days but can be faster with the host project owner included.

kyle: pinging finance and product leads. Please mark any blockers in the ticket so I can expedite approvals internally.

maria: Thanks all. Once quota is approved we'll do a dry-run deploy in staging to validate image boot times and driver compatibility. Keep this thread updated with the support ticket link and any follow-ups from GCP. :thumbsup:
